implementation_boundary: Exactly six online requests: commit, root tree and raw index for each of two commits.
Only commit and tree API JSON are parsed.
Raw index bodies are hashed in memory, never JSON-decoded and never persisted.
Git blob SHA-1 is recomputed from raw bytes and bound to each tree entry.
The historical route proves provenance only and is not substituted into V14.
The first frozen-route identity mismatch stops all census and performance work.
